lines.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. A song.
God arises. His enemies are scattered,
and those who hate Him flee His presence.
As smoke is blown away,
You will drive them out;
as wax melts before the fire,
the wicked will perish in the presence of God.
But the righteous will be glad
and rejoice before God;
they will celebrate with joy.
Sing to God!
Sing praises to His name.
Exalt Him who rides on the clouds—
His name is the LORD—
and rejoice before Him.
A father of the fatherless
and a defender of widows
is God in His holy habitation.
God settles the lonely in families;
He leads the prisoners out to prosperity,
but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.
O God, when You went out before Your people,
when You marched through the wasteland,
Selah
the earth shook and the heavens poured down rain
before God, the One on Sinai,
before God, the God of Israel.
You sent abundant rain, O God;
You refreshed Your weary inheritance.
Your flock settled therein;
O God, from Your bounty You provided for the poor.

pictures.scene: Albin Egger-Lienz, Auf dem Kirchenchor — the singers gathered up in the loft beside the organ to lead the singing, for the choirmaster a Psalm of David a song
pictures.name: pd_egger_lienz_auf_dem_kirchenchor

pictures.scene: Abraham van Calraet, Ruitergevecht — the riders broken apart and driven back across the field, God arises His enemies are scattered, and those who hate Him flee His presence
pictures.name: pd_calraet_ruitergevecht

pictures.scene: Claude Monet, Aankomst van de Normandietrein — the smoke of the engine rising under the roof and thinning away into nothing, as smoke is blown away You will drive them out
pictures.name: pd_monet_aankomst_van_de_normandietrein

pictures.scene: Joseph Wright of Derby, De smidse — the iron going soft and white in the heat of the forge, as wax melts before the fire, the wicked will perish in the presence of God
pictures.name: pd_wright_de_smidse

pictures.scene: Pieter de Bloot, Boerenkermis — the whole village out of doors keeping its feast together, but the righteous will be glad and rejoice before God, they will celebrate with joy
pictures.name: pd_de_bloot_boerenkermis

pictures.scene: Jan Cornelisz Vermeyen, De bruiloft in Kana — the wedding table with the lute going and the cups filled, sing to God, sing praises to His name
pictures.name: pd_vermeyen_de_bruiloft_in_kana

pictures.scene: Francisque Millet, Berglandschap met bliksem — the lightning coming out of the high cloud over the whole country, exalt Him who rides on the clouds, His name is the LORD
pictures.name: pd_francisque_millet_berglandschap_met_bliksem

pictures.scene: Nicolaas van der Waay, De Amsterdamse wezen — the orphan girls of the city walking together in the clothes the house gave them, and rejoice before Him, a father of the fatherless
pictures.name: pd_van_der_waay_de_amsterdamse_wezen

pictures.scene: William-Adolphe Bouguereau, De heilige vrouwen bij het graf — the women in their mourning clothes come to the tomb at first light, and a defender of widows is God in His holy habitation
pictures.name: pd_bouguereau_de_heilige_vrouwen_bij_het_graf

pictures.scene: Meester van Alkmaar, Het bezoeken van de gevangenen — the prisoners reached through the bars and brought what they need, God settles the lonely in families, He leads the prisoners out to prosperity
pictures.name: pd_meester_van_alkmaar_het_bezoeken_van_de_gevangenen

pictures.scene: Alberto Pasini, Karavaan in de woestijn — the line of camels crossing the burnt empty country, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land, O God when You went out before Your people
pictures.name: pd_pasini_karavaan_in_de_woestijn

pictures.scene: Philips Koninck, Vergezicht met hutten aan een weg — the road running out across the wide empty land under a great sky, when You marched through the wasteland, Selah
pictures.name: pd_koninck_vergezicht_met_hutten_aan_een_weg

pictures.scene: Roelant Roghman, Berglandschap met waterval — the whole weight of the water coming down off the rock face, the earth shook and the heavens poured down rain, before God the One on Sinai
pictures.name: pd_roghman_berglandschap_met_waterval

pictures.scene: Gustave Caillebotte, Regendag in Parijs — the people out under their umbrellas with the street wet through, before God the God of Israel, You sent abundant rain O God
pictures.name: pd_caillebotte_regendag_in_parijs

pictures.scene: Philips Wouwerman, Landschap met zandweg — the beasts brought down to the water at the ford on the sandy road, You refreshed Your weary inheritance, Your flock settled therein
pictures.name: pd_wouwerman_landschap_met_zandweg

pictures.scene: Pieter Gerardus van Os, Landschap met vee — the cattle lying full and quiet in the open pasture, O God from Your bounty You provided for the poor, the Lord gives the command
pictures.name: pd_van_os_landschap_met_vee
